meta.subject: Science
meta.source: Government of Tamil Nadu Science Standard Six Term III 2024 English and Tamil editions supplied by the user
meta.extraction_policy: Source-exhaustive bilingual framing from lesson text, ecosystem diagrams, activities, food-chain/energy material, waste hierarchy, SWM 2016 text, numerical infographic, pollution sections, ICT, evaluation and HOTS. No outside corrections are silently inserted.
source_notes: Both uploaded Term III 2024 English and Tamil books were used.

The printed Evaluation matching section displays crossed/mismatched pairings (for example biotic factor–terrestrial ecosystem and sewage–land pollution). The bank does not treat those printed mismatches as a correct answer key; concepts are answered from the lesson text.

The evaluation multiple-choice item on excessive pesticides/fertilizers points to water pollution, while the lesson also describes excess agricultural chemicals as a cause of land pollution. Questions preserve the relevant source context instead of forcing one universal classification.
The waste-hierarchy graphic and surrounding text are preserved as printed; questions distinguish the 3Rs from the wider hierarchy steps such as Avoid, Compost, Incinerate and Landfill.

The HOTS answer about removing an organism from a food chain is kept at the source-supported level: feeding relationships and ecosystem balance are disrupted, without inventing species-specific outcomes.
